scope: verify output confinement relative to live package/recipe and historical source/missing/inventory identities
schema/path validation, ordered stored paths and no-overwrite behavior
findings: Live package, output, recipe and reconstructed paths are constrained through canonical absolute/relative validation, no-symlink checks and new-directory/O_EXCL creation. Existing files cannot be overwritten.

Manifest and pinned plan must match exact selected scope; recorded inventories bind their roots/member/stat identities, original rows and compression metadata. Ordered part/direct path checks and exact package inventory reject path substitution and unexpected members.

Historical original/source/missing/inventory names are foreign-machine lexical identities. Their protection is intentionally lexical; source-independent verification must not dereference all old paths on the destination host. Live target checks remain separate.
resolved_review_point: A proposed blanket symlink-ancestor check for historical paths was withdrawn after peer review: it would reject intended Linux-/tmp to Mac-/private/tmp portability. No provenance-aware alias extension is required for this supplemental byte archive.
not_claimed: No execution of capture/verify or fixture suite by this reviewer
No guarantee against malicious concurrent filesystem mutation beyond implemented before/after guards
